provider_auth_required.message: The provider sign-in has expired or was revoked.
provider_auth_required.resolution: Reconnect the provider account used by this agent, then retry the run.

codex_auth_required.message: ChatGPT sign-in has expired or was revoked.
codex_auth_required.resolution: Reconnect your ChatGPT account in the agent settings, then retry the run.

provider_credential_rejected.message: The configured provider credential was rejected.
provider_credential_rejected.resolution: Open the agent settings, reconnect the provider account or select a valid API key, then retry.

provider_permission_denied.message: The configured credential does not have permission to access the requested provider or model.
provider_permission_denied.resolution: Select a credential with access to this model in the agent settings, or choose an accessible model, then retry.

model_unavailable.message: The selected model is not available to this agent.
model_unavailable.resolution: Check the provider configuration and select an available model in the agent settings, then retry.

proxy_unavailable.message: The runtime could not connect to the model proxy.
proxy_unavailable.resolution: Check that the backend is healthy and reachable from the runtime, then retry.

proxy_response_invalid.message: The model proxy rejected the model discovery request.
proxy_response_invalid.resolution: Check the provider endpoint and backend logs, then retry.

runtime_restarted.message: The runtime restarted before this turn finished.
runtime_restarted.resolution: Review the retained output before retrying: some actions may already have completed, so the turn was not replayed automatically.

agent_process_exited.message: The agent process stopped before reporting a result.
agent_process_exited.resolution: Open the run logs to inspect the last output. Check the runtime image and memory limits before retrying.

terminal_start_failed.message: The runtime could not start the agent terminal.
terminal_start_failed.resolution: Check the runtime startup logs and image configuration, then retry the run.

credential_projection_timeout.message: The runtime could not load this turn's credentials before startup timed out.
credential_projection_timeout.resolution: Check that the configured credentials still exist and that the runtime can mount its credential bundle, then retry.

runtime_events_unavailable.message: The runtime event reporter could not initialize or save an event.
runtime_events_unavailable.resolution: Check the runtime startup logs and available workspace storage, then restart the runtime.

runtime_unavailable.message: The runtime became unavailable before a result was recorded.
runtime_unavailable.resolution: Review the run logs and runtime capacity, then retry after the runtime is available.

provider_rate_limited.message: The provider could not complete this turn because its rate limit was reached.
provider_rate_limited.resolution: Wait for the provider's limit to reset or select a credential with available capacity, then retry.

provider_billing_required.message: The provider account does not have enough credit or an active billing entitlement.
provider_billing_required.resolution: Check the provider account's billing or subscription, then retry.

provider_error.message: The provider could not complete this turn.
provider_error.resolution: Review the run logs for the provider response and check provider availability before retrying.

unknown_exit.message: The agent stopped without reporting a structured failure reason.
unknown_exit.resolution: Open the run logs to inspect the last output, then check the agent configuration before retrying.
